bleake-trophy-01.title: Offshore crane
steps: Reach the north end of the crane.

bleake-trophy-02.title: Waterfront wall
steps: Shoot the weak wall from the bridge to the southwest, then climb inside.

bleake-trophy-03.title: Waterfront warehouse
steps: Climb to the warehouse’s upper floors.

bleake-trophy-04.title: Electrified floor
steps: Order the robot to collect the trophy and return, then defeat it.

bleake-trophy-06.title: Trail toward ACE

bleake-trophy-07.title: Under ACE Bridge
steps: Look behind the generators beneath the bridge.

bleake-trophy-08.title: ACE sign
steps: Pull out the anchor point with the Power Winch.

bleake-trophy-09.title: Wooden waterfront panels
steps: Glide from the roof through the wooden boards.

bleake-trophy-10.title: Chinatown sewers
steps: After part four of Gunrunner, look beside the gate control panel.

bleake-trophy-11.title: Three robots, three rounds
steps: Defeat the robots three times, reviving them with the question-mark switch between rounds.

bleake-trophy-12.title: Race to Osamu Tower
steps: Activate the generator at 1665, 3171. Eject from the Batmobile and glide to the trophy before time runs out.

bleake-trophy-13.title: Robot and sentry guns
steps: Send the robot to disable the first sentry. Blind the second, order the robot to fetch the trophy and return, then defeat it.

bleake-trophy-14.title: Winch and generator
steps: Pull out the anchor point, then activate the generator with the Remote Electrical Charge.

bleake-trophy-15.title: Abandoned building
steps: Collect the trophy upstairs beneath the crane.

bleake-trophy-16.title: Under the boardwalk
steps: Use the Batclaw from the boat ramp.

bleake-trophy-17.title: Two anchor points

bleake-trophy-18.title: Window beside the monorail
steps: Glide from the track through the weak window.

bleake-trophy-19.title: Race to Mendo Soap
steps: Activate the generator at 3496, 2540. Drive across the bridge, then eject and glide to the trophy.

bleake-trophy-20.title: Weak ceiling
steps: Shoot the ceiling beneath the building spanning the road, then use the Batclaw.

bleake-trophy-21.title: Moving targets
steps: Pull the winch and shoot the dots as they cross the rings, leaving the middle one until last.

bleake-trophy-22.title: Under the train
steps: Pull the train with the winch and enter the uncovered floor grate.

bleake-trophy-23.title: Canal pinball
steps: Control the winch carefully: launch the ball past the hatch without hitting the upper corner.

bleake-trophy-24.title: Steam-filled container
steps: Pull out the wall and apply Explosive Gel facing the pipes. Release, detonate and pull again, then slide inside.

bleake-trophy-25.title: Two rooftop pads
steps: Put the robot on one pad and Batman on the other, then use the Batclaw.

bleake-trophy-26.title: Canal ramp
steps: Break through the doors with the Batmobile, then climb to the catwalk.

bleake-trophy-27.title: Suspended container
steps: Glide or drop through the open door facing the water.

bleake-trophy-28.title: Rooftop shelter
steps: Search the western corner of the Panessa rooftop.

bleake-trophy-29.title: Wall target sequence
steps: Park the Batmobile on the pad and quickly shoot each illuminated question mark.

bleake-trophy-30.title: Trail from Panessa
steps: Scan the rooftop panel and follow the trail through the sewers. Shoot the target beneath the canal bridge.

bleake-trophy-31.title: Shield and missiles
steps: Supply power with the winch. Fire a Missile Barrage, then immediately use an EMP to lower the shield.

bleake-trophy-32.title: Rotating glass panels
steps: Turn the panels with the winch and hit each question mark when exposed.

bleake-trophy-33.title: Tower on the rooftop route
steps: Destroy the tower’s weak wall with the Batmobile.

bleake-trophy-34.title: Boarded waterfront wall
steps: Glide from the roof through the wooden boards.

bleake-trophy-35.title: Platform under Merchant Bridge
steps: Drop to the platform above the water southeast of Merchant Bridge.

bleake-trophy-36.title: Lighthouse stall
steps: Search the wooden stall at the foot of the lighthouse.

bleake-trophy-37.title: GCPD display case
steps: Break the glass of the Riddler display opposite the evidence room entrance.

bleake-riddle-01.title: Bones beneath the warning light
steps: Scan the smoking bones in the building beneath the offshore crane.

bleake-riddle-02.title: Langstrom’s laboratory
steps: After the first Man-Bat encounter, enter the laboratory and scan the whiteboard on the left.

bleake-riddle-03.title: Deacon’s Mission
steps: Scan the mission’s sign at street level.

bleake-riddle-04.title: Oracle’s suit
steps: Activate the bust in the clock tower, hack the panel and scan the suit in the closet.

bleake-riddle-05.title: Masquerade ball
steps: Scan the poster on the clock tower’s third floor.

bleake-riddle-06.title: Bat-Signal
steps: Scan the Bat-Signal on the GCPD rooftop.

bleake-riddle-07.title: Arkham Asylum
steps: From the Falcone water tower, look east, zoom in and scan the asylum across the water.

bleake-riddle-08.title: Lady of Gotham
steps: Scan the statue on the central island.

bleake-riddle-09.title: The reporter’s desk
steps: In GCPD’s maximum-security interrogation room, scan the table covered in documents.

bleake-riddle-10.title: Cash’s family
steps: Scan the family photograph on the desk beside Aaron Cash at GCPD.

bleake-riddle-11.title: The mercenary’s file
steps: In GCPD’s communications room, scan the board showing Deathstroke, Arkham Knight and Scarecrow.

Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

bleake-breakable-02.title: Happy Halloween

Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

bleake-breakable-03.title: Chinatown Urbarail
steps: Left of the station’s red sign.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

bleake-breakable-04.title: Sushi and tattoos
steps: High between the Sushi restaurant and tattoo shop.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

bleake-breakable-05.title: Facing the clock tower
steps: On the building wall facing the clock tower.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

bleake-breakable-06.title: McKenzie’s Gems
steps: High in the alley behind the sign.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

bleake-breakable-07.title: Empty canal
steps: On the wall near the sewer entrance.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

bleake-breakable-08.title: Dixon Dock West
steps: On the southwest wall; shoot from across the water.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

bleake-breakable-09.title: Panessa radio tower
steps: Below the radio tower, on the wall facing the road.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

bleake-breakable-10.title: Panessa parking lot
steps: At the top of the northeast gate.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

bleake-breakable-11.title: Lighthouse ramp
steps: On the bridge support beside the lighthouse exit ramp.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

bleake-breakable-12.title: Panessa station
steps: On the side of the raised walkway.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

bleake-breakable-13.title: Sionis crane
steps: On the crane supports at the back of the compound.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

bleake-breakable-14.title: Northeast of GCPD
steps: On the southern wall of the building opposite.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

bleake-breakable-15.title: GCPD eastern wall
steps: On the station’s eastern wall.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

bleake-bomb-01.title: Chinatown above the street
steps: Step onto the pad between the buildings and search the street below.
Fly a Remote Controlled Batarang close to the rioters until you identify the target highlighted in red.
Disarm the bomb by hitting the target with the Remote Electrical Charge. Alternatively, fly a Batarang through nearby sparks to electrify it and guide it into the target.

bleake-bomb-02.title: Clock tower east
steps: Step onto the pad northeast of the tower and search beneath the parade floats.
Fly a Remote Controlled Batarang close to the rioters until you identify the target highlighted in red.
Disarm the bomb by hitting the target with the Remote Electrical Charge. Alternatively, fly a Batarang through nearby sparks to electrify it and guide it into the target.

bleake-bomb-03.title: Northern Chinatown rooftop
steps: Step onto the rooftop pad and search the streets below.
Fly a Remote Controlled Batarang close to the rioters until you identify the target highlighted in red.
Disarm the bomb by hitting the target with the Remote Electrical Charge. Alternatively, fly a Batarang through nearby sparks to electrify it and guide it into the target.

miagani-trophy-01.title: Mercy Bridge support
steps: Enter the small room on the west side of the support.

miagani-trophy-02.title: Waterfront weak wall
steps: Shoot the wall from Mercy Bridge.

miagani-trophy-03.title: Bridge robot
steps: Destroy the wall. Move the robot behind the panel, crush it, revive it and order it onto the pad.

miagani-trophy-04.title: Mausoleum

miagani-trophy-05.title: Cathedral trap

miagani-trophy-06.title: Race to the cathedral

miagani-trophy-07.title: Bridge gears

miagani-trophy-08.title: Wall over the water
steps: Jump to Wayne Tower in the Batmobile and shoot the wall, then reach the opening with the Line Launcher.

miagani-trophy-09.title: Wayne Tower fire escape

miagani-trophy-10.title: Trail from Wayne Tower
steps: Follow the scanner trail to Grand Avenue Station. Hack the shutter and shoot the target inside.

miagani-trophy-11.title: Opposite windows
steps: Glide through either weak window.

miagani-trophy-12.title: Grand Avenue train
steps: Collect the trophy on top of the stationary train.

miagani-trophy-13.title: Station floor grate
steps: Search beneath the hatch on the northwest side of the upper floor.

miagani-trophy-14.title: Miagani tunnels
steps: Collect the trophy on the ledge above the main room.

miagani-trophy-15.title: Lacey’s Department Store
steps: Pull the sign upward with the winch, then shoot the exposed weak wall.

miagani-trophy-16.title: Paul’s Diner
steps: Use the Batclaw behind the counter.

miagani-trophy-17.title: Grand Avenue skyscraper
steps: Climb to the top of the skyscraper west of the station.

miagani-trophy-18.title: The Gotham Pony
steps: Pull open the hatch and enter. Destroy the sentry with the remote-controlled Batmobile before leaving.

miagani-trophy-19.title: Boarded tower
steps: Glide from the rooftop, turn back and break through the boards.

miagani-trophy-20.title: Dang-Good Donut
steps: Glide into the sign’s ring and collect the trophy inside.

miagani-trophy-21.title: Two sliders

miagani-trophy-22.title: Gotham Herald wall
steps: Glide from the building to the south through the boards.

miagani-trophy-23.title: Gotham Herald robots
steps: Only attack green robots; the question mark swaps their colors. Defeat them all, then use the Batclaw.

miagani-trophy-24.title: Casino weak wall
steps: Destroy the wall halfway up the building with the Batmobile.

miagani-trophy-25.title: Jump from the parking garage
steps: Jump from the garage ramp onto the roof, then power the generator with the winch.

miagani-trophy-26.title: Four switches
steps: Robot on the lower pad; gel on the two support switches. Batman on the other pad: Batarang the other two and detonate within three seconds.

miagani-trophy-27.title: Hospital scanner trail
steps: Scan and follow the trail to the target at 2866, 2201, then shoot it.

miagani-trophy-28.title: Orphanage column
steps: Pull the top anchor and repel the upper generator. Pull the middle anchor, activate the second generator, then pull the bottom anchor.

miagani-trophy-29.title: Orphanage rooftop
steps: Look under the shelter in the northeast corner.

miagani-trophy-30.title: Orphanage targets
steps: Batmobile on the pad: shoot each illuminated target and use a Missile Barrage for the final sequence.

miagani-trophy-31.title: Station balcony
steps: Search the northeast balcony of the elevated station.

miagani-trophy-32.title: Tower elevator
steps: Enter the stalled elevator in the metal tower.

miagani-trophy-33.title: Botanical storage room
steps: Search the shelf in the upper-floor storage room on the west side.

miagani-trophy-34.title: Illuminated plants
steps: Search among the pots on the southern upper floor.

miagani-trophy-35.title: Hanging monorail car
steps: Drop into the carriage through its open side door.

miagani-trophy-36.title: Three dock pads
steps: Put the two robots on two pads and Batman on the third, then use the Batclaw.

miagani-trophy-37.title: End of the pier
steps: Collect the trophy on the rooftop beyond the Ferris wheel.

miagani-trophy-38.title: Lady of Gotham
steps: Glide through the boards in the scaffolding beneath the statue.

miagani-riddle-01.title: The League’s return

miagani-riddle-02.title: Wonder Tower

miagani-riddle-03.title: The Wayne portrait

miagani-riddle-04.title: Quincy Sharp for mayor

miagani-riddle-05.title: The Vicki Vale Show
steps: Scan the neon sign on the rooftops.

miagani-riddle-06.title: Hell’s Gate
steps: Scan the sign beside the road.

miagani-riddle-07.title: A flower for Ivy

miagani-riddle-08.title: Elliot Memorial Hospital
steps: Frame the entire hospital from the southeast and scan it.

miagani-riddle-09.title: The cat’s collar
steps: Scan Catwoman’s collar inside the orphanage.

miagani-riddle-10.title: Riddler’s blueprint
steps: In the Final Exam room, hack the panel and scan the blueprint on the desk.

miagani-breakable-01.title: Mercy Bridge

miagani-breakable-02.title: Dolphin sign

miagani-breakable-03.title: Bank of Gotham

Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

miagani-breakable-04.title: Grand Avenue tunnel
steps: Above the tunnel entrance.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

miagani-breakable-05.title: Eastern tunnel
steps: Above the tunnel entrance at the coordinates.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

miagani-breakable-06.title: East of the station

Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

miagani-breakable-07.title: Wayne Tower waterfront
steps: Jump the Batmobile from the northwest ramp and look on the western wall.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

miagani-breakable-08.title: Parking garage

miagani-breakable-09.title: Koul Brau

Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

miagani-breakable-10.title: Horse-statue stairs

Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

miagani-breakable-11.title: Eastern facade
steps: High on the east-facing wall.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

miagani-breakable-12.title: Pinkney Orphanage
steps: On the orphanage’s eastern wall.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

miagani-breakable-13.title: Newton Fairgrounds

Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

miagani-breakable-14.title: Gotham Tonight north

Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

miagani-breakable-15.title: Gotham Tonight entrance

Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

miagani-bomb-02.title: Wayne Tower northwest
steps: Pad in the northwest corner: search north across the water, near the Cuffs sign.
Fly a Remote Controlled Batarang close to the rioters until you identify the target highlighted in red.

Fly a Remote Controlled Batarang close to the rioters until you identify the target highlighted in red.

founders-trophy-01.title: Docks lighthouse
steps: Climb to the upper deck and watch out for the sniper.

founders-trophy-02.title: Trade House
steps: Glide from the roof through the boards facing the water.

founders-trophy-03.title: Opposite the Fish Market
steps: Glide through the boards on the waterfront wall.

founders-trophy-04.title: Pressure-pad floor
steps: Open with the winch and stand on the green pad. Release the anchor, then cross with the Line Launcher without touching red pads.

founders-trophy-05.title: Ruins over the water
steps: Enter the ruined building above the slums.

founders-trophy-06.title: Race to Killinger’s
steps: Activate the pad at 2147, 1492, then drive down into the slums before time runs out.

founders-trophy-07.title: Construction-site robot
steps: Power the generator with the winch and order the robot onto the pad.

founders-trophy-08.title: Shelter beneath the arch
steps: Clear the checkpoint and climb to the sheltered ledge.

founders-trophy-09.title: Three hidden switches
steps: Pull the winch, hit all three question marks with quick Batarangs, then use the Batclaw.

founders-trophy-10.title: Sentry behind the shutter
steps: Open using the generator and shield the sentry with the question mark. Collect the trophy, release the sentry against the robots, then close it again.

founders-trophy-11.title: Slum robots
steps: Order a robot onto the pad. Enter, use gel on the wall, crawl through the vent and defeat the robots.

founders-trophy-12.title: Under the ramp
steps: Search the ditch below the construction-site ramp.

founders-trophy-13.title: Slum scanner trail
steps: Scan and follow the question marks. At the fan, surface through the matching manhole, continue the trail and destroy the target.

founders-trophy-14.title: Wayne International Plaza
steps: Collect the trophy on the east-facing balcony.

founders-trophy-15.title: Unfinished station
steps: Search the yellow crate in the northern waiting area.

founders-trophy-16.title: LexCorp balcony
steps: Robot on one pad, Batman on the other. Use smoke and the Batclaw before the robot attacks.

founders-trophy-17.title: Pretty Dolls Parlour
steps: After The Perfect Crime, enter the floor grate and destroy the weak wall with gel.

founders-trophy-18.title: Spiked door

founders-trophy-19.title: Stairs in the ruins
steps: Collect the trophy on the upper stairs.

founders-trophy-20.title: Ruins weak wall
steps: Shoot the northern wall from a raised position.

founders-trophy-21.title: Scanner trail and jump
steps: Follow the scanner trail, pull the ramp and jump with the Batmobile, then shoot the final target.

founders-trophy-22.title: Bank of Gotham

steps: Blind the sentry and order the robot to fetch the trophy and return, then defeat it.

founders-trophy-25.title: Under Penitence Bridge
steps: Drop to the platform above the water south of the bridge.

founders-trophy-26.title: Magnetic ball

founders-trophy-27.title: Elevated-road weak wall

founders-trophy-28.title: Scaffolding

founders-trophy-29.title: Port Adams office

founders-trophy-30.title: Container and robots

founders-trophy-31.title: Race to Port Adams

founders-trophy-32.title: Three container bars

founders-trophy-33.title: Crane platform
steps: Drop beneath the crane on the east side of the port.

founders-riddle-01.title: Motionless fishermen

founders-riddle-02.title: Grundy’s song

founders-riddle-05.title: Wayne Manor

founders-riddle-06.title: Professor Pyg’s circus

founders-riddle-07.title: GothCorp

founders-riddle-08.title: Cobblepot Manor
steps: Scan the sign above the door north of Port Adams.

founders-riddle-09.title: Bane’s equipment

founders-riddle-10.title: The Dark Knight’s steed

founders-breakable-02.title: LexCorp

founders-breakable-04.title: Gotham Stock Exchange

founders-breakable-05.title: Opposite the fire station
steps: On the grey building north of the fire station.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

founders-breakable-06.title: Road walkway
steps: Beneath the walkway spanning the road.
Destroy it with the Batmobile cannon.

founders-breakable-07.title: South of the church

founders-breakable-08.title: Statue courtyard

founders-breakable-09.title: Port Adams east entrance

subway-trophy-02.title: Drone storage room

steps: Enter the vent above the fingerprint door and hit all three question marks with quick Batarangs.

stagg-trophy-11.title: Alpha two pads
steps: Hack the panel and lead the monkey onto both pads, changing the barriers with the question mark.

stagg-trophy-12.title: Alpha monkey
steps: Hack, activate the question mark and lead the monkey onto the pad.

stagg-trophy-13.title: Beta monkeys below the door
steps: Hack, move right and hit the question mark. When both monkeys stand on the pads, lock them there with the switch.

stagg-trophy-14.title: Beta voice lock
steps: Use the Voice Synthesizer on the door in the laboratory’s northeast corner.

stagg-trophy-15.title: Beta three generators
steps: Enter through the southern vents and activate the three ceiling generators.

stagg-trophy-16.title: Beta western monkeys
steps: Hack, lead both monkeys onto the pads and lock them in place with the question mark.

stagg-trophy-17.title: Beta steam vent
steps: Freeze the pipe on the northern wall and crawl inside.

stagg-trophy-18.title: Beta cell
steps: Use the computer upon entering Subject Testing and search the opened cell.

stagg-trophy-19.title: Beta crates and hatches
steps: Gel the southern wall, unlock the crates and tilt left. Climb through two hatches. Tilt right, lock the crate beside the grate, tilt back and drop down.

stagg-trophy-20.title: Beta exterior crate
steps: Open the voice lock opposite the sentries. Tilt right, then send the crate through the window; collect the trophy on the platform below.

stagg-trophy-21.title: Beta airlock
steps: Open with the button and stand on the pad. Guide a Batarang to Alpha’s rightmost question mark as it lights up.

stagg-riddle-01.title: The white monkey
steps: Alpha Research Laboratory: scan the albino monkey beneath the entrance platform.

stagg-riddle-02.title: The reporter and Deadshot
steps: Beta Biological Engineering: scan the magazine on the northern upper-level desk.

stagg-riddle-03.title: Refrigerated transport
steps: Beta airlock office: scan the flyer beside the stability controls.

stagg-breakable-01.title: Alpha entrance corridor
steps: At the end of the corridor, opposite the first trophy.
Grab the ring with the Batclaw and pull it down.

stagg-breakable-02.title: Alpha crate room
steps: In the corner beneath the ladder.
Grab the ring with the Batclaw and pull it down.

stagg-breakable-03.title: Alpha passage to Beta
steps: Above the platform at the door toward Beta.
Grab the ring with the Batclaw and pull it down.

stagg-breakable-04.title: Alpha main room
steps: On the platform opposite the entrance.
Grab the ring with the Batclaw and pull it down.

stagg-breakable-05.title: Alpha stability controls
steps: Right of the console behind the voice lock.
Grab the ring with the Batclaw and pull it down.

stagg-breakable-06.title: Alpha first shaft
steps: After the underground puzzle, grapple up and turn around.
Grab the ring with the Batclaw and pull it down.

stagg-breakable-07.title: Alpha beneath the stairs
steps: On the shelf beneath the laboratory stairs.
Grab the ring with the Batclaw and pull it down.

stagg-breakable-08.title: Alpha laboratory corner
steps: On the shelf in the left corner from the entrance.
Grab the ring with the Batclaw and pull it down.

stagg-breakable-09.title: Alpha above the laboratory
steps: Above the laboratory at the back of the room.
Grab the ring with the Batclaw and pull it down.

stagg-breakable-10.title: Beta Cloudburst
steps: On the shelf right of the stairs leading to the security door.
Grab the ring with the Batclaw and pull it down.

stagg-breakable-11.title: Beta southeast corner
steps: On a shelf on the lower floor of Biological Engineering.
Grab the ring with the Batclaw and pull it down.

stagg-breakable-12.title: Beta beneath the stairs
steps: Beneath the southern stairs leading to the glass-roofed platform.
Grab the ring with the Batclaw and pull it down.

stagg-breakable-13.title: Beta northern vent
steps: Above the high vent entrance on the northern wall.
Grab the ring with the Batclaw and pull it down.

stagg-breakable-14.title: Beta weak wall
steps: Use Explosive Gel on the southern wall of Subject Testing.
Grab the ring with the Batclaw and pull it down.

stagg-breakable-15.title: Beta airlock
steps: On top of the cage in the airlock.
Grab the ring with the Batclaw and pull it down.

panessa-trophy-01.title: Electrified Batarang
steps: Electrify a Batarang above the Batcomputer, then guide it through the window and down the stairs to the fuse box.

panessa-trophy-02.title: Stairway switches
steps: After trophy 1, climb the stairs and turn off every question mark with Batarangs.

panessa-trophy-03.title: Robots and fear
steps: Enter the vent, break through the wall and use a Fear Multi-Takedown before the timer expires.

panessa-trophy-04.title: Robot statue
steps: Pull the chest ring with the Batclaw.

panessa-trophy-05.title: Rotating statue
steps: The question mark changes direction; the Electrical Charge starts or stops rotation. Stop at A, B and C without crossing Reset.

panessa-trophy-06.title: Three electrified pads
steps: Open using the generator. From the first pad, use the Line Launcher and turn to reach the second. Head back toward the trophy and turn to the third.

panessa-trophy-07.title: Stage A colors
steps: Use Batarangs to match the colors displayed in the opposite room.

panessa-trophy-08.title: Statue generator
steps: Climb behind the backdrop, open the statue’s chest with the Batclaw and overload the generator.

panessa-trophy-09.title: Stage A sentries
steps: Blind one sentry and disable the other from behind, then reapply the hack and disable the second.

panessa-trophy-10.title: Stage B fan
steps: Hack the panel above the fan to stop it.

panessa-trophy-11.title: Steam above the set
steps: Climb to the hatch, cross with the Line Launcher and walk on the wire. Freeze both vents and grapple up.

panessa-trophy-12.title: Mines under the stairs
steps: Disable the mines with the upgraded Disruptor and slide beneath the wall.

panessa-trophy-13.title: Explosive counterweight
steps: Lower the weight and place gel facing the wall. Raise it and detonate beside the weak wall.

panessa-trophy-14.title: Middle-room vent
steps: From the pressure pad, guide a Batarang through the vent to the question mark in the west room.

panessa-trophy-15.title: Ball and steam pipes
steps: Freeze the vent behind the ball each time it stops until it reaches the exit.

panessa-trophy-16.title: Sabotaged weapons crate
steps: Freeze the vent and climb up. Sabotage the crate with the Disruptor and order the robot to open it.

panessa-trophy-17.title: Three vent throws
steps: Gel the wall and step on the pad. First Batarang: right, left. Second: right to the new switch. Third, electrified: right, right, then the fuse above the trophy.

panessa-trophy-18.title: The stages of life
steps: Activate the generators in this order: pregnancy, baby, toddler, running child, young person, businessman, elderly man, gravestone.

panessa-trophy-19.title: Stage C mirror
steps: Turn away from the trophy and fire the Electrical Charge at the question mark above the vent.

panessa-trophy-20.title: Color memory
steps: Follow the letters’ color. Sequences: blue-green-red-yellow; yellow-green-blue-blue-yellow-red; green-blue-yellow-red-blue-red-yellow-green.

panessa-trophy-21.title: Slot machine
steps: Hack the controls beneath the reels and stop each on the same symbol.

panessa-riddle-01.title: Weapons in front of the cell
steps: Scan the weapons in front of the cell nearest the elevator.

panessa-riddle-02.title: A candlelit love
steps: Open the voice-locked door near Stage A and scan the statue among the candles.

panessa-riddle-03.title: Inferno poster
steps: In the room on the right when entering Stage A, scan the poster and boxes in one frame.

panessa-breakable-01.title: Cell corridor
steps: On the floor between Quarantine Cells and Backstage.
Destroy the jack-in-the-box with a Batarang.

panessa-breakable-02.title: Backstage stairs
steps: At the top of the stairs on the left as you enter.
Destroy the jack-in-the-box with a Batarang.

panessa-breakable-03.title: Backstage grate
steps: Beside the grate on the left wall.
Destroy the jack-in-the-box with a Batarang.

panessa-breakable-04.title: Stage A cactus
steps: On the floor beside the cactus on the way to Stage A.
Destroy the jack-in-the-box with a Batarang.

panessa-breakable-05.title: Stage A right room
steps: On the floor in the room to the right as you enter.
Destroy the jack-in-the-box with a Batarang.

panessa-breakable-06.title: Stage A left room
steps: On the desk in the left-hand room.
Destroy the jack-in-the-box with a Batarang.

panessa-breakable-07.title: Stage B entrance
steps: In the right corner beside the main door.
Destroy the jack-in-the-box with a Batarang.

panessa-breakable-08.title: Stage B bookshelf
steps: Beside the bookshelf in the minigunner corridor.
Destroy the jack-in-the-box with a Batarang.

panessa-breakable-09.title: Stage B west room
steps: On the crates in the western room.
Destroy the jack-in-the-box with a Batarang.

panessa-breakable-10.title: Stage B middle room
steps: On the floor beside the trophy in the middle room.
Destroy the jack-in-the-box with a Batarang.

panessa-breakable-11.title: Stage B east room
steps: On the floor beneath the trophy in the eastern room.
Destroy the jack-in-the-box with a Batarang.

panessa-breakable-12.title: Toward Stage C
steps: Turn left at the end of the corridor.
Destroy the jack-in-the-box with a Batarang.

panessa-breakable-13.title: Stage C weak wall
steps: Use gel on the weak wall beside the entrance.
Destroy the jack-in-the-box with a Batarang.

panessa-breakable-14.title: Mirror corridor
steps: On the couch in the corridor with the keypad.
Destroy the jack-in-the-box with a Batarang.

panessa-breakable-15.title: Stage C office
steps: Crawl through the vent from the mirror corridor.
Destroy the jack-in-the-box with a Batarang.

hq-trophy-01.title: Ball track
steps: Lower the Batmobile with the winch. Shoot the question marks to block the holes: first one ball, then two together.

hq-trophy-02.title: Screens and timing
steps: Hit the switch when the orange circle reaches the green question mark. Complete three rounds.

hq-trophy-03.title: Upper workbench
steps: Reach the first generator room and search the workbench.

hq-trophy-04.title: Upper-room pipes
steps: Hack the door and use the Electrical Charge on the switch to align the pipes as the ball passes.

hq-trophy-05.title: Three wheels
steps: Hack the wheels; a Batarang changes direction. Start with all buckets at the top: rotate the first left, second right and third left.

hq-trophy-06.title: Rotating maze
steps: Use the eastern vent beneath the second fan. Repel until ball and exit share a section, then attract.

hq-trophy-07.title: Elevator weak wall
steps: Move the elevator beside the weak wall with the Electrical Charge and use Explosive Gel.

hq-trophy-08.title: Behind the curtain
steps: Take the first elevator down and look behind the curtain by the exit.

hq-trophy-09.title: Bar Lounge sign
steps: Look above the pink sign after the second elevator.

hq-trophy-10.title: Sentry and fuse box
steps: Blind the sentry and step on the pad. First Batarang: vent, left, end, right to the switch. Blind again, electrify the second Batarang and hit the fuse.

hq-trophy-11.title: Panel under the floor
steps: Hack the door near the second fan, then the panel below the floor, and use the Batclaw.

hq-trophy-12.title: Under the elevator
steps: From the bottom, climb above the blocked Excavator entrance. Send the elevator up and drop into the shaft.

hq-trophy-13.title: Eastern room planter
steps: South entrance: look beneath the vantage point in the eastern room.

hq-trophy-14.title: Two balls, two colors
steps: Hack the southern door in the east room. Align the first pipes before starting. Right ball enters first green: rotate green. Left leaves first red: rotate red. Right reaches lower pipe: green. Left enters second red: red. Right leaves second green: green. Right enters third green: green. Left enters third red: red.

hq-trophy-15.title: Southern walkway
steps: Look beneath the walkway’s weak flooring.

hq-trophy-16.title: Robot and two sentries
steps: Hack the upper eastern door. Blind right, order the robot to disable left, blind right again, step on the pad and use the Batclaw.

hq-trophy-17.title: Western room planter
steps: Search the planter at the back of the lower floor.

hq-trophy-18.title: Rotating ball puzzle
steps: Electrical Charge: attract three times, repel four times, attract three times.

hq-trophy-19.title: Chinese restaurant
steps: Enter the floor vents beneath the central table.

hq-trophy-20.title: Screen memory
steps: Hack the screens and match every pair of identical pictures.

hq-trophy-21.title: Vent toward the Excavator
steps: From the upper center, follow the vents toward the Excavator. Use the Batclaw on the opposite wall before dropping down.

hq-riddle-01.title: The white rabbit
steps: North entrance: between the fans, reach the southern elevator and descend, then scan the rabbit mannequins.

hq-riddle-02.title: The fear-filled shop
steps: South entrance, southern room, lower floor: scan the shop filled with yellow gas through its window.

hq-riddle-03.title: Revenge in photographs
steps: South entrance, western room, lower floor: scan the board beside the ammunition crates.

hq-breakable-01.title: Shaft entrance
steps: On the right wall before lowering the Batmobile.
Destroy the spider drone with a Batarang.

hq-breakable-02.title: Shaft left wall
steps: On the left side near the entrance.
Destroy the spider drone with a Batarang.

hq-breakable-03.title: Upper shaft
steps: Lower the Batmobile with the winch and look above you.
Destroy the spider drone with a Batarang.

hq-breakable-04.title: Between the fans, right
steps: On the right wall between the two fans.
Destroy the spider drone with a Batarang.

hq-breakable-05.title: Between the fans, elevator
steps: On the ledge wall toward the elevator.
Destroy the spider drone with a Batarang.

hq-breakable-06.title: Below the second fan
steps: In the passage on the shaft’s eastern side.
Destroy the spider drone with a Batarang.

hq-breakable-07.title: First elevator exit
steps: High on the right wall of the exit room.
Destroy the spider drone with a Batarang.

hq-breakable-08.title: Bottom of the shaft
steps: Climb to the northern ledge and look on the left wall.
Destroy the spider drone with a Batarang.

hq-breakable-09.title: Under the second elevator
steps: On the underside of the elevator in the upper shaft.
Destroy the spider drone with a Batarang.

hq-breakable-10.title: South entrance, east room
steps: On the left wall as you enter the eastern room.
Destroy the spider drone with a Batarang.

hq-breakable-11.title: South room upper wall
steps: High on the left wall as you enter.
Destroy the spider drone with a Batarang.

hq-breakable-12.title: South room escalator
steps: Beneath the escalator, on the lower ceiling.
Destroy the spider drone with a Batarang.

hq-breakable-13.title: West room ceiling
steps: In the center of the lower-floor ceiling.
Destroy the spider drone with a Batarang.

hq-breakable-14.title: West room upper wall
steps: High on the left wall as you enter.
Destroy the spider drone with a Batarang.

hq-breakable-15.title: Chinese restaurant
steps: On the northern room’s ceiling.
Destroy the spider drone with a Batarang.
